wood_kit:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Production source material kit for modular wooden room tiles in the existing cozy pixel ranch. Attached keeper is the accepted pixel density / simple warm palette reference; do not draw any character.
Make exactly FOUR isolated rectangular asset swatches arranged2columns x2rows on a true transparent background, with generous transparent gutters.
Top-left: straight wooden wall front facing surface, horizontal rectangle48x24 logical pixels, warm brown planks with simple darker structural strip at bottom, 1px dark-brown contour, no giant studs, no grass, no endcap perspective. Flat orthographic front surface.
Top-right: wooden FLOOR tile, rectangle48x42 logical pixels, full edge-to-edge matte desaturated light warm wood; calm plank pattern with very subtle seams. No frame or dark outline around outside of floor; no cast shadow. Must be easy to join with copies.
Bottom-left: ordinary CLOSED wooden DOOR LEAF only (no frame), rectangle30x30 logical pixels, a few simple vertical warm wood boards,2horizontal braces, small muted brass handle on right; plain approachable ranch construction, no ornate mansion style, no text. Opaque wood. No stone, lock or hinges outside leaf.
Bottom-right: wooden wall TOP CAP surface, rectangle48x12 logical pixels, flat lighter wood grain with simple long calm grain clusters, no external cast shadow. This will be cut into the wall connection union, so keep it rectangular.

Strong unifying palette: dark brown#382519, deep wood#784321, mid#99653f, light#bc9569, cream#e5c89c with restrained muted shadows. The FLOOR should be low contrast so pets and item drops read. Walls should look like solid plank construction not fences, buildings, houses or logs. Lighting upper-left, flat2-3tones per surface, clean square pixels. Display all four as nearest-neighbor enlarged small-native-pixel artwork; preserve relative shape proportions, not a detailed painting. No characters, roof, flowers, animals, ground, words, numbers, gridlines, labels, shadows or extra objects. True RGBA transparency only outside swatches.
